design.purpose: A weatherproof-looking outdoor planter for herbs or flowers for one gardener; interior about 36 × 14 cm with 20 cm soil depth.

steps.c: Place the wide board flat for cutting.
Cut front, back and both 14 cm ends.
Place the second board flat for cutting.
Place the base flat on the floor.
Stand the front side on the base.
Stand the back side on the base.
Fit the left end between the sides.
Fit the right end between the sides.
Screw the front to the left end.
Screw the front to the right end.
Screw the back to the left end.
Screw the back to the right end.
Screw the base up into the front.
Screw the base up into the back.
Screw the base up into the left end.
Screw the base up into the right end.
